annotations.title: Search QuickMatch AI game dev tools

description: Find AI tools for making video games in QuickMatch's checked list, filtered by category, engine, free plan, starting price and commercial use. Returns up to 10 tools with free plan, price, commercial-use terms, the date prices were checked and a quickmatch.si link. Commercial-use values are shown exactly as stored: yes, no, checking, n/a, limited, attribution.

category.description: Tool category: maker (AI game makers), code (AI coding and engine assistants), art (2D art and sprites), 3d (3D models and worlds), anim (animation and mocap), music (music and sound effects), voice (voices and NPC dialogue), vibe (vibe-coding builders).

commercial.description: true: only tools whose free plan allows commercial use (commercial.free is "yes"). Possible stored values: yes, no, checking, n/a, limited, attribution.

engine.description: Game engine the tool works in or exports to: godot, unity, unreal, roblox, gamemaker.

free.description: true: only tools with a free plan (the free plan line starts with "Yes"). false: only tools without one.

maxPrice.description: Highest starting price (the tool's lowest listed paid plan, as a plain number in the vendor's own currency, which isn't always US dollars). Tools whose starting price is unlisted (null) or still "checking" are excluded when this is set.

query.description: Optional words to match against tool names, what they are best for, summaries and features, e.g. "pixel art sprites".
